name: Espresso
description: A double shot of our house blend, with notes of dark chocolate and toasted hazelnut.

name: Cortado
description: Equal parts espresso and steamed milk for a smooth drink that still tastes of the coffee.

name: Flat white
description: A double ristretto under a thin layer of velvety microfoam. Rich, silky and not too milky.

name: Cappuccino
description: Espresso with steamed milk and a deep cap of foam, dusted with cocoa if you like.

name: Salted caramel latte
description: Espresso, steamed milk and house-made salted caramel, finished with a pinch of sea salt.

name: Mocha
description: Espresso with dark Belgian chocolate and steamed milk. Ask for whipped cream on top.

name: Butter croissant
description: Laminated over three days with French butter for a crisp, flaky outside and a soft center.

name: Almond croissant
description: Our croissant filled with almond frangipane, topped with toasted almonds and powdered sugar.

name: Cinnamon cardamom bun
description: Soft brioche dough rolled with cinnamon and cardamom sugar and finished with an orange glaze.

name: Blueberry lemon muffin
description: Bursting with blueberries, with a lemon zest crumb topping. Baked fresh every morning.

name: Pain au chocolat
description: Flaky croissant pastry wrapped around two bars of dark chocolate.

name: Turkey and brie
description: Roasted turkey, creamy brie, fig jam and arugula on toasted sourdough.

name: Caprese ciabatta
description: Fresh mozzarella, vine tomatoes, basil pesto and a balsamic glaze on warm ciabatta.

name: Smoked salmon bagel
description: Cold-smoked salmon, dill cream cheese, capers and red onion on a sesame bagel.

name: Breakfast sandwich
description: Free-range egg, aged cheddar, smoked bacon and chipotle mayo on a brioche bun. Served until 11am.

name: Cold brew
description: Steeped for 18 hours for a smooth, low-acid coffee with notes of cocoa and dark cherry.

name: Iced vanilla oat latte
description: Espresso, oat milk and house vanilla syrup, poured over ice.

name: Nitro cold brew
description: Cold brew infused with nitrogen for a creamy, cascading pour with a natural sweetness.

name: Iced matcha latte
description: Ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with milk and lightly sweetened, poured over ice.

name: Sparkling yuzu lemonade
description: Fresh lemon and yuzu topped with sparkling water. Bright, tart and caffeine-free.
